inclusion_rule: Recursively include each distinct repository-relative path exactly once iff the pinned commit tree records a regular blob (mode 100644 or 100755) whose path has the case-sensitive byte suffix .jsonl. This is a complete tree census: detector output, file contents, session state, and local uncommitted files are not eligibility filters. Equal-content files at different paths remain separate.

limits.behavior_on_limit: fail before publishing any snapshot; never filter

provenance: Committed lane transcript fixture corpus only; this is NOT a private live-session corpus. Source bytes were retrieved as inert data with git show; no transcript snippets were executed.
